'''May 2001 New York tournament (20 May)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament on 20 May 2001. It is known from Hayes Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2536">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-27-a-weekend-with-kyle-craftd2536/ a-weekend-with-kyle-craft], DeckTech (Hayes "Hayes" Hunter, 27 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-27-a-weekend-with-kyle-craftd2536/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 May 2001
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
